title: Lacandon | History, Language, Jungle, & Facts | Britannica
text: Lacandon, Mayan Indians living primarily near the Guatemala border in the Mexican state of Chiapas. Some Lacandon may live in Belize, across the eastern border of Guatemala. The Lacandon are divisible into two groups, the Northern and Southern Lacandon. Estimates of their population range from 300 to 1,000.

title: LACANDON MAYA; Ritual objects and Sacred Places
text: Although instrumental music no longer plays an important part in Lacandon rituals, rattles, conch shell trumpets, and drums are all made by the Lacandones and occasionally have ceremonial use. They make a combination drum and incense burner that is dedicated to Kayum, god of music.
